slow_push.movement: Forward push into subject or scene
slow_push.use_case: Building tension, revealing details, emotional connection

dolly.movement: Smooth lateral tracking left or right

orbit.movement: Circular motion around central focal point

drone_fly.rotation: Tilt and yaw for environmental reveal
drone_fly.movement: Ascent, descent, or lateral tracking from above
drone_fly.use_case: Establishing scope, showing cityscape, grand reveals

zoom.movement: No camera movement, only focal length change
zoom.use_case: Isolating details, building intensity through magnification

handheld.movement: Slight bounce, weight shifts simulating human camera operator
handheld.use_case: Immersion, documentary feel, tension and urgency

whip_pan.movement: Rapid directional pan revealing new subject
whip_pan.use_case: Transition between scenes, dynamic reaction, maintaining energy
